author: Numberz_
body:
Please fix the regions on Rendezvous 2 and add more wood and an axe to the spawn kit. The map is impossible to defend on due to the angle of the wool rooms, plus you keep getting glitched in "You cannot enter your own wool room." and can't move. Pls fix and ill love you 5ever.

Thanks,

Numberz
